## Case Studies (10 Detailed Projects)

### 1. KPI Scoring Engine (Growth Central VC)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/kpi-scoring-engine.html
- Category: Operations & Business Analysis
- Focus: Designed a weekly balanced KPI scoring model over 3 iterations (V1 for the departments I oversaw, V2 and V3 for the HR teams only: 3 HR teams, 12 groups, 60 recruiters). Timeline: V1 built August 2021, V2 built March 2022, V3 started June 2022 and live August 2022. Wrote the BRD and 13 user stories, mapped ERDs, ran 22 UAT test cases traced to stories, and built a PostgreSQL to Power BI pipeline tracked in JIRA.
- Formula: Score = 5A + 2B - 6C + 10D - 4E (A = Ads Posted, B = Sourced, C = Shortlists Created, D = Interviews Passed, E = Unselected Candidates C - D).
- Tools: Excel, Power BI, PostgreSQL, DBeaver, JIRA, draw.io

### 2. Maruti Suzuki XCELerate: EV Market Entry Strategy
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/maruti-suzuki-xcelerate.html
- Category: Strategy & Consulting
- Achievement: Semi-Finalist (Top 20 overall, 10 per track), from 51,866 registrations nationwide (roughly 16,000 to 25,000 teams).
- Focus: Formulated an electric passenger vehicle market entry strategy for Maruti Suzuki. Recommended launch in Delhi and Karnataka backed by charging-station density data, targeted the mid-range "ideal customer" (first-time car buyers seeking feature-rich, comfortable vehicles), and developed the "Maruti Suzuki eBharat" go-to-market concept (#eBharatRoadTrip) on affordability and low running cost.
- Tools: Market Sizing, Competitive Positioning, Go-to-Market Strategy

### 3. New Product Line Launch: Expert-Led Courses & PM Program (Growth Central VC)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/pm-course-launch.html
- Category: Product & Incubation
- Outcome: Generated Rs 3,00,000 in first-quarter revenue across the new product line: Rs 2,50,000 from 4 expert-led courses plus Rs 50,000 from the PM program. A new PM cohort started every month from January; each cohort ran 8 weeks with 10 mentees. Personally ran 3 cohorts (30 mentees) before handing it off.
- Tools: Curriculum Design, Cohort Mentorship, Operations Management, Figma, Notion

### 4. Store Operations & Time-Motion Study (Gyasi Ram and Sons)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/store-operations-forecasting.html
- Category: Operations & Business Analysis
- Outcome: Managed store and warehouse operations for a 15-person team (stock checks, replenishment from 6 vendors, packing compliance), cutting customer interaction time from 20 to 12-13 minutes and raising basket size from 2-3 to 4-5 products through structured product education. Built a station line and seasonal forecasting model in Excel as a working prototype.
- Tools: Excel, Time-and-Motion Study

### 5. FluorCo: Hydrofluoric Acid Strategy Diagnostic (Bain BrAINWARS)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/fluorco-turnaround.html
- Category: Strategy & Consulting
- Achievement: Team Member in a 4-person team. Cleared Round 1 of 3 (MCQ assessment plus issue-tree submission), submitted Round 2 entry, and was not selected for Round 3. Diagnosed stagnation of hydrofluoric acid business at roughly 50-year-old manufacturer (40% company CAGR, but HF only one-third of sales) across 4 root causes: 100% import-dependent raw material (fluorspar supply disruption), volatile capacity utilization (37% to 64%), $0 pricing flexibility, and South India concentration (60% of sales). Includes worked utilization calculation from Round 2 appendix (throughput X = 11.25 items/hour, total time t = 1,600 hours, FY22: U = 64%, B = 38.4 mins, S = 3.41 mins).
- Tools: MECE issue trees, financial and utilization calculations

### 6. Godrej Consumer Products: 11-Year DuPont ROE Analysis
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/dupont-analysis-godrej.html
- Category: Strategy & Consulting
- Focus: Deconstructed 11 years of standalone financial reports (FY12 to FY22) using a 3-step DuPont decomposition model. ROE ranged between roughly 18.5% and 23.9% in every year except FY2019 (35.6%, one-off tax year); Total Asset Turnover declined from 0.85x to 0.79x while Fixed Asset Turnover improved from 2.55x to 4.78x.
- Tools: DuPont Ratio Modeling

### 7. Ambulance Routing Network via Graph Theory
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/ambulance-routing.html
- Category: Operations & Business Analysis
- Focus: Course project for DOM208 Operations Research at Shiv Nadar University (2022). Formulated a sample road network with a single hospital base as a directed graph. Applied Dijkstra shortest-path algorithm and bipartite matching to reduce sample round-trip transit time by 10% in a simulated sample (one sample case, patient P2).
- Tools: Graph Theory, Dijkstra Routing, Bipartite Matching

### 8. Daikoku: Student Builder Marketplace
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/daikoku-marketplace.html
- Category: Product & Incubation
- Focus: Co-Founder, Operations, Strategy & Marketing Lead across 4 co-founders (Ops and Strategy, Web Dev, XR/Unity, Ops and Marketing). Co-founder from June 2022 to December 2022. Incubated at SNU Atal Incubation Centre from August 2022. Customer discovery with 21 startups (13 meetings scheduled, 62% conversion rate). Validated demand through 53-student survey: 79.2% were willing to do projects. 60.4% preferred big companies over startups (39.6% startups). About 79% were excited about VR training (50.9% very excited, 28.3% excited). Early revenue of Rs 23,000 from a website-development engagement for one of our outreach targets. This figure is directional, as the books were not formally closed after the team's exit. Platform architecture: a student portal (Google and GitHub sign-in, project listings, embedded workspace, gamified rewards), Swipe Mode (hiring interface where startup HRs filter and message pre-evaluated candidates, backed by SME project ratings and employer verification), and a tiered SaaS toolkit for startups.
- Tools: B2B Outbound

### 9. Campus Recruitment & Structured Interview Pipeline (Growth Central VC)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/campus-recruitment.html
- Category: Operations & Business Analysis
- Focus: Onboarded 15 interns across Management, Sales, Marketing, and HR functions, with 5 converting to part-time roles (33% conversion rate). Partnered with placement cells at 5 institutions (LPU, KMC, DDUC, DTU E-Cell and A₹thaShastra, the economics club of IIM Rohtak), running drives with rotating HR trainees and timing the funnel from March to August 2022.
- Tools: Interview criteria design, Campus partnerships, Funnel management

### 10. Competitor Intelligence: 200+ Competitors Mapped (Growth Central VC)
- URL: https://kshitiz-gupta02.github.io/Portfolio/projects/market-intelligence.html
- Category: Product & Incubation
- Focus: Led a 7-person research team to map 200+ competitors across course learning and skill assessment & certification in a 3-week sprint using the Critical Path Method (CPM). Researched 3 core questions (demand size, price sensitivity, competitive gaps) combining secondary research with surveys of 30+ existing customers. Benchmarked 5 key platforms (Coursera, Udemy, edX, LinkedIn Learning, Skillshare) on price, quality, and distribution; finding that few major competitors combined low price with high perceived credibility directly drove the launch of course learning.
- Tools: Critical Path Method, competitor comparison framework
